name: Atlas
overview: Service connections and who-sees-what for the Atlas app
description: The server side of the Atlas app. It keeps your server's service connections (Seerr, Kavita, Sonarr, Radarr, Prowlarr, qBittorrent) with their keys on the server, and decides on the server what each profile can use.

versions.changelog: Delete what you asked for (atlas-app#133): anyone with Requests deletes what they asked for and nobody else did; admins anything.
Make room and Delete (atlas-app#133): Room, Delete/Plan, Delete. Admins only; nothing is deleted unless an admin presses Delete.
Server health (api 10): every check HealthWatch runs, indexers with Test and Reset, disks and logs, through the home layer with its own key (atlas-app #100)
Find: chapters counted by number and one upload of each (Comick listed 736 for Vagabond's 329); ComicVine's sections no longer run into a comic's words; a deleted profile's reading asks go with it.

Cancelling a request also stops Radarr or Sonarr looking: the film, or the seasons asked for, are unmonitored and their downloads removed, unless someone else still wants them or they're already here. Includes 0.9.0 (Find: search manga and comics, ask for one, follow it to the shelf).
Find (atlas-app #99): search manga (Suwayomi) and comics (Mylar3), ask for one, follow it to the shelf. Mylar3 and Suwayomi join the services. API 9.
Deleting a profile now also deletes the Kavita account Atlas made for it, and forgets its reading settings and access. A sweep clears anything left behind by profiles deleted earlier.
Reading: the shelf, series, issues, pages fitted in memory, your place and reading settings, each profile as its own Kavita account (api 8).

Activity (Atlas app #97): what the server is downloading now and how each is doing, what's stuck and why, thirty days of history a page with who asked, and Find another for a stuck download. Get's grabs are noted so History can say who picked them in Atlas. Api 7.
Search every indexer (atlas-app #96): Prowlarr's search for the same film, season or episode, read by Radarr or Sonarr; a grab is pushed to them, so they judge it and import it. Api 6.
Get: Missing counts only other people's requests as asked; other films left out of a film's releases.
Get: releases for a film or season that isn't on the server yet, by its Radarr or Sonarr id.
Get: a title's releases as Radarr and Sonarr judge them, grabbing one, a show's gaps, what's missing, and searching for it.
A title read right after asking, cancelling or deciding shows it straight away.
Requests (atlas-app#95): title pages for anything, one state per request, ask for films or seasons, cancel, approve and decline. API 4.
Lists every profile on Jellyfin 10.11.9 and later, where Jellyfin renamed the call the plugin used.
Who sees what, enforced on the server: per-profile rules for Requests, 4K, Auto-approve, Reading and its libraries, Get, Activity and Server. Seerr permissions are kept in step.
Finds Sonarr, Radarr and Prowlarr on this server even behind their login page, and names the app when a key is used on the wrong one.
Service connections for admins: Seerr, Kavita, Sonarr, Radarr, Prowlarr, qBittorrent and the Atlas home layer, each tested live. Keys stay on the server and never come back out.
First release. GET /Atlas/Hello tells the Atlas app the plugin is installed, which version, and who is signed in.
